scenes.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape inline story painting for chapter 2 of “The Red Notebook”
Primary request: depict the end of paragraph 2: before dawn in steady rain, Mika, her mother and librarian Ms Sato reach the largest town bridge; Ms Sato points out one large crack in the river-side wall.
Input images: Image 1 is the approved simple inline style reference; Image 2 guides Mika's character identity and palette only.
Scene/backdrop: a quiet town bridge in grey dawn rain, with shallow puddles on the road, a swollen brown river below, and a few simple rooftops beyond.
Subject: Mika, a dark-haired young woman in a muted teal cardigan over ivory, stands beside her mother and Ms Sato near the bridge entrance. Ms Sato points toward one clear crack in the concrete side wall. The mother looks at the crack with concern. Show the crack as a warning they can inspect safely; the bridge is intact.
Style/medium: gentle children's picture-book painting in the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal texture, a few purposeful folds and shadows, quiet simplified background; distinctly simpler than the textured cover.
Composition/framing: medium-wide landscape about 12:7, the three figures small but readable, the bridge wall crack visible as the focal clue, two or three broad depth layers.
Lighting/mood: cool early-morning light and steady rain, careful concern without panic.
Color palette: warm ivory, midnight indigo, muted teal, soft slate-grey and restrained brown.
Constraints: show only their discovery of the crack from paragraph 2. Keep everyone safely on the approach; no collapse, damage beyond the single crack, or traffic crossing. No lettering, signs, numbers, captions, title, border, frame or watermark.
Avoid: falling bridge, flood disaster, injuries, panic, police or fire crew (they arrive in the following paragraph), photorealism, glossy 3D, dense brush texture, busy background.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape inline story painting for chapter 2 of the graded-reader “The Red Notebook”
Primary request: depict the end of paragraph 0: at night in steady rain, Mika is awake and worried by the window while her mother checks Ren’s name in the open red notebook, still unsure whether to believe it.
Reference guidance: no image files are attached to this generation. Describe the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, a few purposeful folds and shadows, quiet background, and two or three broad depth layers. The chapter cover informs Mika’s identity and palette only: dark hair tied back, muted teal cardigan and ivory top. Maintain continuity with the existing librarian-and-bridge painting: natural faces and restrained clothes.
Scene/backdrop: a simple home interior at night, one rain-dark window, a small lamp and a plain table. Outside is a quiet dark town with a suggestion of wet trees; do not show the bridge or river.
Subject: Mika sits awake beside the window, looking into the rain. Her mother sits at the table with one plain red notebook open, checking a blank-looking page. The two are calm but uneasy. Ren has already left for school and is not in the room.
Style/medium: gentle hand-painted children’s picture-book art in the simple Kasa Jizō inline style, clearly flatter and quieter than the textured chapter cover; smooth colour planes, few marks, soft contours, readable silhouettes, minimal detail.
Composition/framing: landscape about 12:7, medium-wide interior with Mika and her mother in two broad foreground shapes, window and table behind; two or three calm depth layers.
Lighting/mood: warm small lamp against cool rainy night, sleepless and thoughtful, without panic.
Color palette: warm ivory, midnight indigo, muted teal, soft slate blue, sage and a quiet red accent from the notebook.
Constraints: show only paragraph 0. The notebook has no legible marks, writing, letters, numbers or symbols. No police, umbrella, bridge crack, bus, caption, title, border, frame or watermark.
Avoid: supernatural effects, later events, crying, panic, photorealism, glossy 3D, dense rain texture, detailed wood grain, busy shelves or clutter.

Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: landscape inline story painting for chapter 2 of the graded-reader “The Red Notebook”
Primary request: depict the end of paragraph 1: a sudden gust sends Ms Sato’s blue umbrella rolling off the wet road and into the brown river before anyone can reach it.
Reference guidance: no image files are attached to this generation. Describe the approved Kasa Jizō inline treatment: broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, a few purposeful folds and shadows, quiet background, and two or three broad depth layers. The chapter cover informs Mika’s identity and palette only: dark hair tied back, muted teal cardigan and ivory top. Maintain character continuity with the existing chapter painting: Mika wears teal, her mother a simple taupe coat, and Ms Sato has grey hair and a dark navy coat with a muted rust scarf.
Scene/backdrop: the library entrance and a wet road beside a swollen brown river before dawn. Use a simplified building edge, riverbank and a few broad rain strokes; keep the distance quiet.
Subject: one plain blue umbrella tumbles through a gust above the muddy river and is just touching the water. Mika, her mother and Ms Sato stand safely back on the road, startled but unharmed; no one is in the water.
Style/medium: gentle hand-painted children’s picture-book art in the simple Kasa Jizō inline style, clearly flatter and quieter than the textured chapter cover; broad smooth shapes, soft contours, minimal details, purposeful movement in a few curved rain and wind strokes.
Composition/framing: landscape about 12:7, umbrella and river are the clear focal point, three small readable figures near the library entrance, two or three broad depth layers.
Lighting/mood: cool grey-blue dawn, steady rain and a sudden gust; tense surprise held in a quiet composition.
Color palette: muted slate, midnight indigo, warm ivory, teal and one clear blue umbrella against the brown river.
Constraints: depict only the umbrella falling into the river from paragraph 1. No bridge inspection, crack, police or firefighters, bus, rescue attempt, injuries, legible writing, letters, numbers, signs, captions, title, border, frame or watermark.
Avoid: disaster spectacle, people in water, panic, photorealism, glossy 3D, dense texture, detailed rain, cluttered background.
